title: USCIS Revised Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
paragraphs: On Dec. 10, 2024, we published a new edition ofForm I-485, Application to Register Permanent Resident or Adjust Status, which includes updates to questions and instructions. Starting Feb. 10, 2025, we will accept only the 10/24/24 edition of Form I-485 and will reject any older editions of Form I-485.
The new edition of Form I-485 features these major changes:

Revising the form is part of our agency-wide initiative to reduce the burden on people who apply for immigration benefits and services. Specifically, incorporating Form I-864W into Form I-485 eliminates the need for a separate form.
